C0834.title: Binzhou Police Crack Fraud Case: Suspect Swindled 250,000 Yuan by Promising Job Placement
C0834.summary: In June 2022, Bincheng police cracked a fraud case. The victim, Mr. Liu, was defrauded of 250,000 yuan by a 'friend' surnamed X, who claimed to need money for 'relationship building' and 'greasing the wheels' to secure a job. X exploited the victim's trust in his social connections, representing a typical social engineering scam.
